description: This file defines the Oracle 'quercus' driver class and a specific recordset class for the ADODB database abstraction layer in PHP, including methods for fetching field metadata from Oracle query results.

classes.name: ADODB_oci8quercus
classes.description: A class representing the Oracle 'quercus' driver, extending the base ADODB_oci8 class and setting specific properties for this driver.

classes.name: ADORecordset_oci8quercus
classes.description: A specialized recordset class for Oracle 'quercus' that extends the generic ADORecordset_oci8 class, with custom field fetching logic to handle Oracle-specific data types and metadata.

methods.name: _FetchField
methods.description: Fetches metadata for a specific field from the Oracle query result, including resolving field name, type, length, and scale, with special handling for QUERCUS environment.
